question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Final query with rounded values
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, 
           AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_composition_index
    FROM interest_metrics 
    WHERE month_year IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(month_year, '-', 2) AS INTEGER) * 12 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(month_year, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) 
          BETWEEN (2018*12 + 9) AND (2019*12 + 8)
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_composition_index,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition_index DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_composition_index,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT_PART(r.month_year, '-', 2) AS INTEGER), CAST(SPLIT_PART(r.month_year, '-', 1) AS INTEGER)) as month_seq
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
with_lags AS (
    SELECT 
        t.month_year,
        im.interest_name as top_interest_name,
        t.avg_composition_index as max_index_composition,
        AVG(t.avg_composition_index) OVER (
            ORDER BY t.month_seq
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg_3month,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY t.month_seq) as prev_interest_name,
        LAG(t.avg_composition_index, 1) OVER (ORDER BY t.month_seq) as prev_max_index_composition,
        LAG(im.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY t.month_seq) as prev2_interest_name,
        LAG(t.avg_composition_index, 2) OVER (ORDER BY t.month_seq) as prev2_max_index_composition
    FROM top_per_month t
    JOIN interest_map im ON t.interest_id = im.id
    ORDER BY t.month_seq
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    top_interest_name,
    ROUND(max_index_composition, 6) as max_index_composition,
    ROUND(rolling_avg_3month, 6) as rolling_avg_3month,
    prev_interest_name,
    ROUND(prev_max_index_composition, 6) as prev_max_index_composition,
    prev2_interest_name,
    ROUND(prev2_max_index_composition, 6) as prev2_max_index_composition
FROM with_lags
